## Summary

Land-cover mapping supports environmental and agricultural planning. This study uses the Random Forest algorithm on Sentinel-2 satellite imagery to classify land cover across Jambi province, achieving improved accuracy over baseline methods.

## Contribution

- Applied Random Forest classifier to Sentinel-2 data for Jambi land-cover mapping.
- Quantifies accuracy improvements and discusses feature/pixel settings.
- Published in *Jurnal Ilmu Komputer* (Fasilkom UMRI).
